text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper that meets all core inclusion criteria. It develops and quantitatively compares two future scenarios (Business as Usual and Governance) for 2030 and 2050, using the Dinamica EGO modeling platform. The work reports quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., ROC curves, validation) and produces mapped projections of forest loss.)
